responsibility: Defines regression and behavior tests for `owned_slice` that validate `OwnedSlice`, `slice_owned`, and `try_slice_owned` preserve access to derived slices while keeping the backing owner alive, support repeated reslicing, handle fallible slicing, safely work with boxed storage, run owner drop logic at the right time, and satisfy `Send`/`Sync` trait guarantees.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other same-named test files, this one is about owner-backed slice semantics: it checks that `OwnedSlice` keeps backing storage alive across repeated slicing, handles fallible slicing and boxed owners safely, drops the owner at the right time, and preserves `Send`/`Sync` properties.
